data.reviewed_base: FD revision 11; current implementation diff unchanged from the prior FD-112 review; focused review of stable spec, README, and shutdown call sites
resolved_prior_findings: The README now limits state_dir/requests persistence and local usage statistics to openai_codex and explicitly states openai_proxy does not persist request metadata or provide local usage statistics.
The stable spec retains the development loopback listener/peer and shared explicit-listen requirements as a separate deployment requirement, without restoring App Server lifecycle constraints.

The Local graceful shutdown requirement no longer requires App Server process-tree cleanup; it preserves active backend request cancellation, graceful HTTP shutdown, proxy connection closure, content-cleanup completion, and state-lock release.
results: Shutdown spec semantics match the current main/server shutdown sequence by static inspection.
Direct inference and proxy request contexts remain cancellable through the service context; the shutdown sequence closes HTTP handling and active proxy connections and waits for cleanup completion.
Successful process return closes the Store through deferred cleanup; stop reports completion only after the listener stops and the state lock is released.
No App Server process pool, JSON-RPC, MCP, sandbox, workspace, or process-tree lifecycle requirement was reintroduced in the reviewed stable-spec changes.
The Worker-recorded Windows/Linux compile-only result was reviewed as evidence and not rerun.
